name: service1

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the current catalog of scored records to compute the average score.

description: Public-facing API that reports the average score of Service2's current catalog: the sum of every record's score divided by the record count, truncated to a whole number. Runs the same computation regardless of which catalog Service2 is currently serving — there is no separate path or result per catalog. Returns a structured 404 body for any path it does not serve. Logs how many records it handled per request. Does not hold or mutate the catalog itself, and does not expose or forward Service2's mode-switch control.
